act.long_title: An Act to consolidate, define and amend the law of Evidence.

section.heading: In civil cases character to prove conduct imputed, irrelevant
section.html: In civil cases, the fact that the character of any person concerned is such as to render probable or improbable any conduct imputed to him, is irrelevant, except in so far as such character appears from facts otherwise relevant.
section.text: In civil cases, the fact that the character of any person concerned is such as to render probable or improbable any conduct imputed to him, is irrelevant, except in so far as such character appears from facts otherwise relevant.
